observed_facts.value: Q3 $31.9B; approximately two-thirds short-lived assets primarily GPUs/CPUs; next quarter >$40B; calendar 2026 ~ $190B including ~ $25B component-price impact
Revenue $81.6B (+85% YoY); Data Center $75.2B (+92% YoY); Q2 revenue guide $91B +/-2% excluding China Data Center compute

reunderwrite_rules.green_continuation: At least two hyperscalers maintain or raise real compute commitments, accelerator/custom-ASIC demand remains strong, and TSMC revenue/guidance remains intact.
reunderwrite_rules.yellow: Nominal capex stays high but real compute content weakens, cloud growth slows, rates/real yields rise materially, FX/ADR basis moves unusually, or export restrictions tighten without operating impairment.
reunderwrite_rules.red: At least two hyperscalers materially cut real compute plans together with weaker AI/cloud demand and concurrent deterioration in TSMC revenue/guidance; or structural technology/packaging failure; or verified geopolitical operating impairment.

governance: Macro context is evidence and scenario input, not an automatic trade signal.
